name: 78582 · Rio Grande Cy, TX
findings: ZIP 78582 (Rio Grande Cy) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78582 (Rio Grande Cy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78582 (Rio Grande Cy) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
